# BYZ scope. Calm enough for this line's events (design 3.2): no civil war, no theme revolt, no Byzantine intrigue,
# C7's blockade not running, the Ottoman interregnum not under way.
oe_l7_calm = {
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
    oe_bi_active = no
    oe_byd_running = no
    NOT = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_done } } }
}
# BYZ scope. The Ottomans exist, are AI, are nobody's subject and have not joined the empire (house of Osman's chain).
oe_l7_ott_ok = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } c:TUR = { is_ai = yes is_subject = no } }
# BYZ scope. The doom (design 3.2): the siege comes only when the empire is truly weak. Each condition apart:
# 1 the window 1440.1.1 - 1481.1.1; 2 the City is ours, our capital, under our control, not besieged; 3 the Ottomans hold
# Adrianoúpolis and a neighbour of the City; 4 their army is at least 2.5 times ours; 5 we hold at least one place
# besides the City (an empire of the City alone never enters this line, design 六 item 4); 6 no war with the Ottomans,
# we are nobody's subject, Rome has not been restored.
oe_l7_d1 = { current_date >= 1440.1.1 current_date < 1481.1.1 }

oe_l7_d4 = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { army_size >= oe_l7_ott_x } }
oe_l7_d5 = { any_owned_location = { count >= 2 } }
oe_l7_d6 = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } is_subject = no NOT = { has_global_variable = rome_reconquista_is_end } }

# BYZ scope. The chronicle (gen_chronicle.py row l7, a hook in plan_20261117/v67/l7-siege1_实施.md). The chronicle tests
# void, then ended, then under way. Void: never besieged (6), or closed without an end. Ended: any other end (1-5;
# after a bought peace the siege may come once more). Under way: the fortress is built or the sultan is at the walls.
oe_l7_over = { OR = { has_variable = oe_l7_off current_date >= 1481.1.1 } }
oe_l7_chr_void = { OR = { var:oe_l7_end ?= 6 AND = { oe_l7_over = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_end } } } }
oe_l7_chr_done = { has_variable = oe_l7_end }
oe_l7_chr_run = { OR = { var:oe_l7_st ?= 1 var:oe_l7_st ?= 2 } }
